text:
Marco: Quick sync — OpenModelX is ready to onboard. Need final decisions on redistribution rights and how we package the marketplace SKUs. Who owns the announce and handoff to SI?
Leah: Who from legal owns redistribution clause? Also what's the embargo window we want for the public PR?
Amy (Legal): I can own redistribution language. We need provenance attestation and export checks before listing. Draft approach: non-exclusive redistribution with attribution + prohibition on raw weights resale. Embargo: propose 48h after marketplace goes live, unless partners request NDA-gated private listing.
Sanjay: For the HW bundle: do we list combined SKU (model+appliance) or separate model SKU + hardware SKU with a bundle discount? Marketplaces typically prefer separate SKUs and a bundle. cc Chris for product implications.
Chris: Separate SKUs sound safer — model can update independently. For GTM I suggest a 1-week stagger: private listing -> press release -> customer webinar. Keeps us flexible for any last-minute rollback.
Marco: SI integrator needs ~3 weeks lead for joint deployments. Can we canary with Dedicated customers first before public PR?
Leah: That works. Proposed schedule: Week 0 internal canary w/ 2 Dedicated customers, Week 1 private marketplace listing (NDA-gated), Week 2 public announce + webinar. Amy — okay with embargo moving to accommodate this?
Amy (Legal): OK if private listing is NDA-gated and we add logo/license controls. I'll add partner logo usage and a short case-study clause. Need partner to confirm PII/no-weights export restrictions.
Sanjay: HW partner prefers separate SKUs. They want co-marketing credit and a 60-day case study window post-launch. Also asking for a short promotional allowance in the marketplace landing tile.
Marco: Action items: Amy share redistribution clause draft, Leah draft release cadence/ops runbook, Chris prepare marketplace SKU mapping and PR outline, Sanjay confirm HW pricing and promo ask. I'll produce the SI handoff doc with timelines.
sdk-bot: Checklist created: /docs/partnerships/openmodelx-gomarket-checklist.md :white_check_mark:
Amy (Legal): Uploading draft license snippet to the checklist now:
```text
Redistribution: Partner may redistribute model binaries in compiled/serving form under a non-exclusive, non-transferable license.
Attribution: Partner must display \"Model: OpenModelX (licensed via Redwood Inference)\" in product materials and marketplace tiles.
Prohibited: Resale or distribution of raw model weights or uncompiled checkpoints.
Export: Partner must comply with applicable export controls; attestations required prior to public listing.
```
Leah: Looks good to me. Marco — can you assign PR owner and ops owner?
Marco: Assigning owners: PR - Chris, Ops - Leah, Legal - Amy, HW Pricing & Promo - Sanjay. I'll ping SI leads for the deployment window and post the handoff doc by EOD.
Chris: I have a draft PR outline; will drop it into the partnership channel tomorrow and request partner review. Need final partner logo files and a 2-3 sentence partner blurb.
Sanjay: I'll get logos + hardware SKU list by end of day Friday.
Marco: Great — once logos and legal draft are in, we can lock the private listing and start the canary.
Leah: Thanks all. We'll reconvene on Tuesday to confirm slots and finalize the checklist. :calendar:
